mapper.select: SELECT config_key, config_value, secret, updated_by, updated_at FROM t_system_config
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_system_config (config_key, config_value, secret, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{configKey}, #{configValue}, #{secret}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt}) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE config_value = incoming.config_value, secret = incoming.secret, updated_by = incoming.updated_by, updated_at = incoming.updated_at
